story_so_far: Day 1: Hamid (Lahore) got 82% in 12th but the university fee is Rs 2,00,000 a year; he tore the admission form and wrote PLAN B. Day 2: first job at a chai dhaba, 12 hours; burned hand, broke a cup, paid Rs 450 (Rs 1,200). Bilal arrived with a 'paise double' scheme. Day 3: Bilal's scheme - they each put Rs 1,000 into 10 'cheap' phones at the bazaar; at home all were plastic dummies. Angry at first, then they laughed together on the rooftop. Rs 200 left. Diary: 'Aaj bhi bach gaye. Kal: teen naukriyan!' Day 4 (Teen Naukriyan): 5 AM newspaper round on an old cycle - chain broke, finished 40 houses on foot chased by a dog (+Rs 150); late to the dhaba, Rs 100 cut (+Rs 350); night tuition for Ali (Class 5) - fell asleep, Ali's ammi caught him, but Ali said 'sir taught best today', she paid Rs 300 and said 'kal bhi aana'. Rs 1,000. Cliffhanger: an unknown number calls about a delivery job - battery 1%, phone dies. Day 5 (Phone Mar Gaya): phone dead; charger plugged in - loadshedding; Bilal had sold his charger (scheme #2); paid Rs 50 at a generator mobile shop, but balance zero; a kind stranger (Chacha, white topi + beard) lent his phone. Job confirmed: delivery rider, Rs 25,000/month - in KARACHI, day after tomorrow 9 AM. Bus ticket Rs 1,500 vs Rs 950 in pocket (Rs 550 short). Cliffhanger: Ammi overheard - 'Karachi? Tum Karachi ja rahe ho?'
